description:
476 interior designed apartments with state-of-the-art amenities including a residents'  gym & studio, media room & games room, two private dining spaces, a designated co-working space and shared lounges. Residents also have access to a range of spectacular rooftop terraces with views of the city including the iconic Edinburgh Castle.

Get ahead of the crowd-reserve your apartment today!

YOUR APARTMENT

Furnished studio apartment with open-plan living, kitchen and dining space situated on the 3rd floor.

Double bed with Ottoman storage and feature headboard.

Shower Room with deluxe rainfall shower.

Cosy living area with 2-seater sofa and dining space for two.

Fitted kitchen with integrated Samsung appliances.

Floor-to-ceiling windows.

YOUR KITCHEN

Open-plan, sleek and modern with quartz worktops and integrated Samsung appliances including touch control induction hob, combi oven, fridge with icebox freezer, dishwasher and washer dryer. Room to dine with marble-effect dining table and two chairs.

YOUR LIVING AREA

Light and spacious with floor-to-ceiling windows. Luxurious two-seater sofa, media storage unit with 50" Samsung 4K Smart TV and coffee table with mirrored top.

YOUR BEDROOM

Stylish bedroom including fitted wardrobes with full-height internal mirror, double bed with Ottoman storage, feature headboard and 1,000 individual pocket-sprung mattress made from natural materials.

YOUR BATHROOM

Shower Room with contemporary porcelain tiling throughout. Deluxe sized rainfall shower with separate handheld shower, WC and heated towel rail, plus bespoke vanity cabinet with LED lighting.

Council Tax Band: C

Landlord Registration: 523836/230/21052
